appearances.snippet: He says he walked in and gave the footage to the Orem Police Department, okay? And they said, "You know, we were overwhelmed on that day one," which makes sense.

verification.notes: This claim describes testimony from a witness about their interactions with the Orem Police Department and federal investigators regarding footage they captured. While the speaker presents this as fact based on what the witness told them, there is no independent documentation or official confirmation available to verify the specific timeline of when footage was submitted to Orem PD or when federal investigators first contacted this witness. This is witness testimony being relayed secondhand.

records.text: A second videographer told Owens that authorities likewise had never contacted him.
records.speaker: Rooftop-position videographer in Ep K5GjF53bfN4 (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Now I'll tell you what else I discovered, because a lot is going on, and we similarly, by the way, reached out to the person who shot the footage and said, "Somebody is on the roof." ... We spoke about that earlier this week. He told us the exact same thing.

verification.notes: Owens claims she contacted a witness who filmed video of the Charlie Kirk shooter and that the witness said neither federal nor local police had contacted him. However, this is an unverified secondhand account. Multiple sources confirm that FBI and local authorities conducted extensive witness interviews after the assassination. News reports indicate 'thousands of students' were present and prosecutors noted the process to identify witnesses could be laborious. Without identifying the specific witness or independent confirmation, this claim cannot be verified. Sources: https://www.cnn.com/2025/09/29/us/tyler-robinson-charlie-kirk-court, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Assassination_of_Charlie_Kirk

records.text: Harpole said Orem Police had an active drone unit and a mutual-aid agreement with UVU, and recounted that Orem officers said UVU had not asked them for assistance.
records.speaker: Brian Harpole

appearances.snippet: Orem PD has a drone unit, active and professional. ... "Do you have an MOU or a mutual aid agreement with the school?" ... And they're like, "Yeah." ... I said, "Did they call you and ask for assistance?" ... "No."

verification.notes: Verified as Harpole’s attributed account. In the recorded interview clip, he said Orem Police had an active drone unit, recounted confirmation of a mutual-aid agreement, and said officers answered no when asked whether UVU requested assistance. Associated Press reporting independently confirms that Orem Police had drones and was not involved in event security; it does not independently establish every detail of Harpole’s retelling.
